title: Ideas for the future
transcriptText:
Big idea: Recording-first memory safety
Whenever software handles personal voice notes, the original audio must be treated as sacred. Never wait on transcription before committing audio to disk.
Write raw PCM chunks continuously so a crash never erases a thought.
Keep a persistent SQLite queue that survives restarts and retries cleanly.
Let word-level highlighting turn fleeting speech into lasting editorial notes.
